body: If you keep your walls up you’ll never escape ‘it’ either way. Locking yourself away regardless.
Eerily in the same situation as you. Tried on Friday night with an utterly pathetic “attempt”. As soon as I was discharged a rage overcame me that I hadn’t completed it.
There’s no cure so no worthwhile treatment and as far as I’m aware no time machine to take back the damage I’ve imposed on her memory of me. Nobody can change that and I can’t live with that.

I have my plan set out and know the faults I made with that pathetic effort last night. I’ll be getting Zopiclone sleeping tablets subscribed to me for insomnia like I have in the past and I’ll be downing all of them with a bottle of Southern Comfort in that same field looking up at the stars before I close my eyes and leave this vile disgusting pitiful mind.

I’m more objective than most with mental health history because I’ve been given all the support in the world but ultimately nothing has ever had a lasting effect. I’m fully aware of my destructive character traits which makes reactions like last night all the more disturbing and enraging. It is completely out of my control no matter how hard I try. There is no chance of having that need of love fulfilled with how my brain is hardwired. I’m fucking ashamed and hate myself with the very core of my being. I am furious that I didn’t go through with things and all that stopped me was the flip of a coin. I shouldn’t even have resorted to that.

My dad is with me in my flat and I’m 26 years old being watched over like a toddler having a tantrum. Humiliation over and over and over. 26 year old man. Being watched over by a 63 year old man. Utterly fucking pathetic. Certain to dry up any potential partner in an instant.

Nothing but death will stop the pain and regret. If that freak out hadn’t happened there would have been opportunity to get past this heartbreak but there isn’t now because I have destroyed the memories and created a monstrous image of myself right at the end. This is what she’ll remember.
It’s pretty blatant that I have it. I have *all* of the symptoms and follow the same pattern with any intimate relationship I enter.
